title: Figure 19: Northrop Grumman Joint High Power Bulk Slab Solid-State Laser in lab
description: Photograph of a technician in a cleanroom suit, hood and goggles working over an optical bench crowded with mirrors, mounts and amplifier modules. Captioned "Figure 19. Northrop Grumman's Joint High Power Bulk Slab Solid-State Laser (courtesy of the Directed Energy Professional Society)." It appears in a section on emergent high-power solid-state and free-electron laser technologies, describing the JHPSSL 7-amplifier chain that reached about 105 kW in 2009.
